newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber steady, tone firm on Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber steady, tone firm on Tokyo.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark SIR20 rubber offer prices were steady in late trading on Monday, with sentiment seen firm on rises in Tokyo, dealers said.
Dealers, however, said trading was slow due to a public holiday in the United States.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries remained at 57.00-57.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and 56.75-57.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.50-57.00 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said SIR20 October/November deliveries was last traded at 57.00 cents/lb FOB Medan in early trade.
One RSS1 dealer said he was holding firm to his offer price of 132.50 cents/kg fob Semarang for October deliveries.
"We've got some bids at 131.50 for the October RSS1, but we are holding firm as prices could firm up in the coming days due to rains," the dealer said.
Another dealer said SIR10 October delivery was last traded at 57.15 cents/lb late on Friday against the previous 56.50-57.00 cents due to firm demand.
Dealers said high amoniac latex was on offer at 2,260 rupiah/kg in Tangerang and Bandung against the previous 2,350 rupiah due to weak demand. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
